state: specified; root/native producer/gateway implementation and acceptance pending
topology: separately attested enrolled Hermes producer and provider gateway; same-peer capture_source handles are not portable bearer authority

producer_api.validation: root itself captures exact complete SDK request envelope bytes from authenticated producer, joins complete immutable parent receipt ancestry, and derives normalized final provider request with protected selected canonicalizer; messages-only snapshot is source ancestry, not sufficient final effect body
producer_api.authority: opaque handle is lookup reference only, unusable except by fixed host-selected gateway peer
producer_api.python_signature: prepare_native_event(payload: bytes, *, parent_receipt_handles=(), purpose, intent_id, trace_id, retry_index=0) -> opaque native_event_handle

gateway_api.validation: authenticate actual gateway SO_PEERCRED + PIDFD/starttime/executable digest/profile/enrollment/generation; require exact protected mapping from producer to gateway, normalized payload digest and retry index match
gateway_api.semantics: single root RPC atomically claims handle, validates full source closure/current policy/account/zero budget/lease, internally issues fresh context+one-use effect and invokes fixed provider handler; caller receives no transferable grant
gateway_api.effect_operation: provider.dispatch fixed target/recipient/capability derived only from protected enrollment and canonical payload
gateway_api.response: bounded eligible provider result/stream or exact redacted error; no secret/context credential leakage
gateway_api.python_signature: dispatch_native_request(handle, normalized_payload: bytes, retry_index=0) -> bounded result/stream

consumption: atomic pending->consuming->consumed; before effect bytes reserve once and consume source admission; concurrent/replayed/stale/cross-peer use denies. Failure does not resurrect grant. Retry requires a newly prepared bridge plus root-observed retry authorization and full unchanged parent lineage, never replay old bridge/context/grant. Receipt ancestry remains retained for provenance; provenance existence does not grant repeat effects.
lease: minimum of source receipt/producer/gateway/context/policy/request deadline; finite existing operation cap; watchdog cancels active egress on expiry/revoke/generation/PID change
no_laundering: unknown/private remains private/ineligible public; transport header only opaque reference, never permission or caller public classification
evidence: actual two enrolled separate processes native positive flow plus wrong gateway PID/exe/gen, producer replacement, digest/canonicalizer mismatch, dropped parents, concurrent reuse, retry replay, expired/revoked lease, private-public bypass before external bytes
receipt_lifetime: source.capture immutable peer-bound receipt may remain as provenance parent until its bounded lease; retaining ancestry is not permission to repeat effect. prepare_native_event captures a NEW exact complete request envelope and bridge admission per attempt. Failed/retried request does not destroy audit ancestry or revive consumed bridge; each new bridge/attempt includes full closure and fresh root retry admission.

protected_authority_config.approved_operation: provider.dispatch only for current native provider bridge
protected_authority_config.joins: producer/gateway profiles join root principals/process_profiles for UID/executable/artifact/profile generation; provider_enrollments derive exact fixed target/recipient/capability/model/account
protected_authority_config.constraints: unique exact bridge per selected producer profile/operation; distinct enrolled role processes; strict finite schema and no wildcard/caller destination; missing/ambiguous joins failclosed
protected_authority_config.dynamic_identity: root process registry resolves currently live PIDFD/starttime/cgroup/exe digest/generation for BOTH peers per prepare/dispatch; config never stores caller-selected PID as authority
protected_authority_config.digest_note: canonicalizer digest is actual protected installed artifact, not invented in planning; absent pin leaves bridge unavailable

api_body_definition: Complete SDK envelope means all supported API BODY fields (model/messages/input/tools/stream/response format and route-supported controls), not transport-only headers, timeout or SDK retry objects. Reject caller extra_headers, bind only root opaque bridge header, enforce root deadline and disable implicit SDK retries. Every retry has new root admission/capture. SIWC rejects its documented unsupported body fields.

normalization_policy.semantics: Root selected canonicalizer applies exact same protected policy before prepare digest and gateway effect. No independent late gateway mutation. Any policy revision invalidates old prepared handles. Ceiling is selected per compatible route, not inferred globally;4096 is permitted only as explicitly enrolled compatible-route bound. SIWC unsupported max_output_tokens stays rejected; never inject it. Caller values cannot widen protected limit.
normalization_policy.evidence: At/below/above ceiling producer and gateway byte equality, absent/altered policy or route schema denies, changed policy invalidates pending bridge; unsupported SIWC fields reject before bytes.

protected_records.digest: normalization_policy_sha256 is SHA256 of canonical sorted compact JSON of preceding record fields EXCLUDING normalization_policy_sha256; canonicalizer_sha256 separately hashes exact installed reviewed canonicalizer bytes. Do not silently conflate module hash and policy hash.
protected_records.binding: native_bridges join exact normalization policy ID/revision/hash and installed canonicalizer identity; policy missing route support/actual full artifact SHA unavailable. Same module can serve both records only if reviewed code implements both exact schemas. No planning partial digest is actual artifact pin.
